NOTE
**Still not ready — the click fix is a separate commit and the testing checklist is incomplete**

New: The author pushed twice and says the failing tests are fixed, but I can't confirm that because CI status isn't available. Missing: The "Fix click behavior" commit should be squashed into the first commit, and the checklist still leaves end-to-end button behavior and corner cases unchecked.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and send the reply below; no reviewer assignment yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please squash the "Fix click behavior" commit into the first commit, since it fixes a bug that commit introduced (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)). Then finish the unchecked self-review items, and confirm that CI is passing.
```
